info.description: This course firstly provides students with basic concepts of machine learning and then neural network kinds with learning algorithms, specially the backpropagation algorithms. The main content of this course is about some typical deep learning models including convolutional neural networks and long-short-term memory models. Students will trained for ability of applying deep learning models to in practice as well as for solving real problems.
